style: cinematic 3D, Pixar fur, bright slapstick, midday light

subject.character: EUROPEAN MAGPIE, black-white plumage, blue-green sheen, hoarder for shiny things
subject.physicality: compact, jerky head moves, wings tight except like hands, rocks on impact; head tilt when pleased, one wing slap, one-sweep gather, otherwise still
subject.consistency: same magpie every segment, no costume changes

cast.sparrow: HOUSE SPARROW money-changer, speckled, brisk; loupe on a cord, brass scale — weighs, taps, rejects; large, close, below the magpie

props.wrapper: candy wrapper, distinct from the foil

environment: sidewalk currency stall, midday, weathered counter, bright daylight, no artificial light

audio.voice: male, warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry, measured
audio.delivery: dry, weary deadpan, calm, native Russian, no accent
audio.pacing: even pace ~4.5 syll/sec, no drawn-out words
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves clearly each syllable, no voice over

timeline.action: MAGPIE drops onto the counter, wings snap shut; foil, wrapper, cap fan from her beak, apart. SPARROW flinches.
timeline.camera: low at counter-edge, tilting up as she drops

timeline.action: SPARROW hops up, grabs the loupe, bends over the objects.
MAGPIE speaks, still and level, every syllable clear, even measured pace. SPARROW sets the wrapper on the pan; it dips, swings.
timeline.camera: low-angle hold on the magpie, creep toward the sparrow's claws and the swinging scale

timeline.action: Silent. The pan settles, SPARROW nods. MAGPIE's tail snaps down in one sharp flick — her only movement — the foil scrap untouched beside the scale.
timeline.camera: push-in tightening on the counter as the scale stops and her tail snaps down

timeline.action: MAGPIE tilts her head sharply, pleased with herself.
timeline.camera: handheld sway on the head tilt

timeline.action: SPARROW raps the cap twice, flicks it aside.
timeline.camera: snap-pan to the wing flick, cap sliding off

timeline.action: MAGPIE slaps one wing flat by the cap, rocking from the impact.
SPARROW shrugs, nudges the cap back toward the pile.
timeline.camera: handheld settle on the claw's nudge

timeline.action: MAGPIE freezes, snaps a look into the lens, head tilt — out of place, a serious line coming.
timeline.camera: push-in on her eye as she looks to camera

timeline.action: MAGPIE speaks. SPARROW lifts the loupe to the case.
MAGPIE speaks. SPARROW snaps the loupe into the case, decisive.
Silent. MAGPIE holds still. SPARROW shuts the loupe case and raps a claw twice, closing the inspection.
timeline.camera: creep-in tightening on the counter as she shuts the case and raps the wood

timeline.action: MAGPIE sweeps the pile into one heap and takes flight; one foil scrap drops back onto the counter.
timeline.camera: whip-tilt up on takeoff, then down to the falling foil

negative_prompt: slow speech, drawn-out delivery, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, burned-in graphics, English speech, foreign accent, night, dusk, lamp light, dim lighting, moody lighting, low key lighting, deep shadows, static camera, locked-off shots, floating objects, floating props, stacked objects, duplicate props, object duplication, extra limbs, a third character or background birds entering frame, magpie or sparrow changing appearance mid-shot, blurry mouth, unclear articulation, voice over, mismatched lip sync, sparrow reduced to a blurry background shape
